text: {"facts":[{"statement":"The task is to find the minimum total cost of dictionary words that concatenate to exactly cover a lowercase text; words may be reused and duplicate spellings with different costs are allowed.","source_ids":["task"]},{"statement":"The text length is at most 100000, there are at most 2000 dictionary entries, word lengths are 1 to 30, and costs are nonnegative and at most 1000000000.","source_ids":["task"]},{"statement":"The first public example has minimum cost 3.","source_ids":["public1"]},{"statement":"The second public example has no valid cover and outputs -1.","source_ids":["public2"]}],"open_requirements":["Select and justify an algorithm that meets the stated constraints, including handling duplicate spellings with different costs.","Specify how unreachable text positions and the no-cover case are represented in the computation."],"tentative_options":[{"id":"trie_dp","method":"Use dynamic programming over text positions, scanning forward from each reachable position through a trie for at most 30 characters; relax the destination using the minimum cost for each matched spelling.","unverified_assumptions":["Trie construction and minimum-cost aggregation for duplicate spellings are implemented correctly.","The resulting O(text length × maximum word length) scan is acceptable."]},{"id":"aho_corasick_dp","method":"Build a multi-pattern matcher and combine its reported word matches with dynamic programming over text positions to minimize cover cost.","unverified_assumptions":["The matcher reports all relevant dictionary matches, including duplicate spellings handled at minimum cost.","The match-reporting and DP work stays within acceptable time and memory bounds."]}],"possible_checks":["Test the provided examples and confirm outputs 3 and -1.","Test a text covered by one word with multiple costs and ensure the least cost is used.","Test an uncovered text position and a text that is completely covered."]}
